Customers.title: Customers
Customers.description: The people and companies you rent to. Each one signs in with their own account to see their leases and the notes you share.

groupsEmpty.current: Nobody occupies any of your properties right now.
groupsEmpty.incoming: Nobody is due to move in.
groupsEmpty.outgoing: Nobody is due to move out.
groupsEmpty.previous: No customer has moved out yet.

Customers.emptyDescription: Add a customer, then assign them a property.
Customers.contactsEmpty: People to reach about this customer: family, a guarantor, an accountant.

create.title: Add a customer
create.description: Creates their sign-in account. You assign properties on their page.

copy.title: Copy customer
copy.description: Starts from {name}'s details and contacts. The copy is a new account, so it needs its own email and password.

Customers.emailHint: They sign in with this email and see their leases and the notes you share.
Customers.emailLocked: Their sign-in email. It can't be changed here.
Customers.passwordHint: Share it with them securely. They can change it from their account.

Customer.notFound: This customer doesn't exist or was deleted.
Customer.leasesEmptyHint: Assign a property to start tracking rent, payments and contracts for this customer.
Customer.deleteDescription: Their account, contacts and notes are removed, and they're signed out everywhere. This can't be undone.
Customer.deleteWithLeasesDescription: Their account, contacts, notes and {count, plural, one {lease} other {# leases}} are removed, and they're signed out everywhere. This can't be undone.
Customer.cantDeleteDescription: Rent payments are recorded for this customer, so they stay on record. Terminate their leases instead.

Leases.assignDescription: The customer occupies it from the entry date, and until the exit date if there is one.
Leases.noProperties: Add a property on the Properties page first.
Leases.rentHint: Per month, due in advance from the entry date. Changes apply to this lease only.
Leases.paymentDescription: Money received against invoice {number} for {property}. {remaining} is left to pay.
Leases.terminateDescription: {property} is freed after the exit date. The lease can't be changed afterwards.
Leases.deleteDescription: Use this for a lease entered by mistake. Its lease document is deleted with it. To end a real lease, terminate it instead.

validation.endBeforeStart: The exit date can't come before the entry date
validation.monthsInvalid: Enter a number of months from 1 to 1188
validation.discountTooLarge: The discount can't be more than the rent, charges and costs together
validation.templateRequired: Choose a template for the lease document
validation.proofInvalid: Use a PDF or an image of up to 10 MB.

Leases.noCustomers: Add a customer on the Customers page first.
Leases.rentFromProperty: Taken from the property. You can change it later from the lease.
Leases.noPropertyRent: This property has no rent set, so the lease starts at 0. Set the rent on the property first, or edit the lease afterwards.
Leases.autoRenewHint: When a term ends, another of the same length starts, until the lease is terminated.
Leases.monthlyHint: Billed every month with the rent: {amount} in total.
Leases.documentHint: Filled in from the template with these terms, signed for your business and sent to the customer to sign. The template needs a customer signature field.
Leases.documentSent: Lease document generated, signed for your business and sent to the customer to sign.
Leases.templateNotSignable: This template has no signature field for the customer. Add one to the template first.
Leases.signatureSetup: Lease documents are signed for your business and sent to the customer right away. <link>Add your business signature</link> to assign a property.
Leases.proofHint: A PDF, or a photo or screenshot of the transfer, up to 10 MB.

MyHome.title: My home
MyHome.description: Your rented places, invoices and documents, and notes from your landlord.
MyHome.empty: Your landlord hasn't linked a lease to your account yet.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.partlyPaid: {paid} paid so far, {remaining} left to pay.

proof.title: Send proof of payment
proof.description: For invoice {number}: attach the bank transfer confirmation or a photo of the receipt. Your landlord confirms it, then the payment shows here with its receipt.
proof.pendingNote: You sent proof of {amount} paid on {date}. Your landlord will confirm it.
proof.rejectedNote: Your landlord couldn't confirm the {amount} you sent proof of on {date}: {reason}
